text_blocks.snippet: Spinal cord injury (SCI) involves both a primary injury from the initial trauma and a secondary injury cascade that progressively damages the spinal cord. The initial trauma causes mechanical damage (primary injury), which then triggers a series of biological events (secondary injury) that can lead to further cell death, inflammation, and impaired nerve signal transmission.
